value.message: The Now Assist menu uses AI to help agents summarize, create, and edit content in emails, chats, articles, and risk explanations. It offers content adjustments for length, tone, and refinement, boosting productivity and communication.
To use the Now Assist context menu, first check the skills tab to see which skills are enabled. You'll need to activate a skill before you can access its features through the context menu

• Get suggestions: Generate a first draft or response suggestion when Now Assist has context.
  • Elaborate: Expand your content with more details after an initial draft by Now Assist or an agent.
  • Shorten: Reduce your text while maintaining the original meaning after an initial draft by Now Assist or an agent.
  • Adjust tone: Modify your content's tone to casual, formal, or sympathetic.
  • Add Skills: Associate custom skills created through Now Assist Skill kit as actions in the Now Assist context menu.

How does Now Assist context menu improve writing?

value.message: The Now Assist context menu allows you to easily create intelligent drafts with consistent tone and style based on the context of a writing task and reduces human errors such as typos.

composition.elementLabel: Can I make changes to the suggested text?

value.message: Yes. The Now Assist context menu provides "shorten" and "elaborate" refinement options to automatically refine the response. After inserting the generated text, the inserted text can also be refined manually.

composition.elementLabel: Can I give feedback on suggestions?

value.message: Yes, by clicking the thumbs up/down icon, you can tell us if a certain response is satisfactory. Feedback can improve the response quality in the future.
